about.title: About Me
about.description: Passionate software engineer focused on creating impactful solutions
about.fullDescription: I am a dedicated software engineer and full-stack developer with experience in web and mobile applications. I specialize in building cross-platform apps using React Native, and I have extensive experience with Laravel, WordPress, and Shopify. Over the years, I have worked on diverse projects including e-commerce platforms, educational apps, corporate websites, and business applications. I thrive in both freelance and collaborative team environments, delivering scalable, maintainable, and user-focused solutions. I enjoy translating client requirements into functional applications that are accessible, high-performing, and visually appealing. My technical toolkit includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Expo, Node.js, MySQL, and REST APIs. I am constantly learning new technologies and best practices to improve my craft. I am committed to creating software that solves real-world problems while providing an intuitive experience for end-users. Beyond coding, I am interested in cloud computing, DevOps practices, and software architecture. I take pride in writing clean, well-documented code and mentoring junior developers whenever possible. I am passionate about accessibility, performance optimization, and creating solutions that have a meaningful impact on businesses and users alike.
